games.name: [BANS] Make an Error
games.desc:
😵 Welcome to Make an Error! (formerly Untitled Error Creator)

Type anything, style it your way, fool your friends, or just be funny!

⚙️ HOW TO MAKE AN ERROR:
• Click the Create Error button at the bottom
• Fill in your title, message, code, and buttons
• Hit the blue Play button to see it in action!

🎨 HOW TO SWITCH ERROR STYLES:
• Press Create Error
• At the bottom right, click the Styles button
• Choose your favorite look, like our brand new Ban style!
• Swap styles anytime to test them all out!

✨ FEATURES:
• 🔠 Custom titles
• 💬 Editable messages
• ⚠️ Fake error codes
• ☑️ Button text editing
• 👥 Share with other players
• 💾 Save and load your errors anytime

🎉 Updates, events & more in the group! JOIN HERE:
https://www.roblox.com/communities/35492849/Little-Plane#!/about

👍 LIKE + FAVORITE if you enjoy the game!
📢 Invite your friends and create errors together!

games.name: A Silent Town
games.desc:
Monsters called "Listeners" have invaded this town, they are blind creatures that have very big ears. You can not escape this town, all the exits are blocked off. You must survive for as long as you can!

- Search around the map for supplies to survive, buildings you spawn in usually have a lot of them!🧰
- Find a Hammer to build a base and block out any openings!🔨
- Survive against the Listeners for as long as you can!🕙
- Monsters can hear your voice with Voice-Chat!🔊
- Earn money to upgrade your stats permanently!💸

Becoming a Listener is free in VIP servers.
Be sure to like and favorite the game if you enjoy!
Your loadout is NOT meant to save, you lose it when you die or leave.

Game is inspired by "GEF", and the movie "A Quiet Place"

games.name: GET OUT [PRE ALPHA]
games.desc:
You weren't meant to survive. You have to GET OUT.

A 2000s retro extraction shooter.

You know what you have to do. 
Deploy, loot, and shoot your way to GET OUT.

- PvPvE extraction runs
- Guns, attachments, armor, skins
- Helicopters and drivable vehicles
- Arcadey systems with a grounded sense of realism
- NO HUNGER, NO STAMINA, AND NO ZOMBIES

This is a solo project still in infancy. GET OUT is visually inspired by titles such as DRIV3R (2004) and SWAT 3 (1999). It is not for sale.
(PS - I am the guy on the thumbnails. Yes I am a LARPer)
